{{Quote|Hope you can handle a blaster, buddy -- I've got a Trandoshan bounty hunter on my tentacles, hired by the Gungans who escaped from Lord Humbonnen.|Slyd Shu'ril|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Slyd Shu'ril''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he was being chased by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and asked [[Lergo Brazee]] to hire a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to escort him out of the wilderness of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to the nearest [[City/Legends|city]].
